name: marked
_note: Pinned per the same project-lead decision as acorn (#1710, 2026-05-29): acquire via a pinned npm-pack tarball, NOT a vendored source copy. The tarball is committed as a fixture so the harness reproduces from a clean checkout with NO run-time network. shasum is the canonical npm sha1 (`npm view marked@18.0.2 dist.shasum`); integrity is the canonical npm sha512 (`dist.integrity`). To refresh: `npm pack marked@<ver>`, update this file, re-run setup. The SAME tarball is the compiled-marked source AND the node-marked differential oracle, so any HTML-output divergence is a compiler bug, never version skew. lib/marked.esm.js is a single self-contained bundle (no imports) — same shape as acorn's dist/acorn.mjs, chosen for the same reason.
